mcp_tools.name: pump_conveyor_motor_suitability_check
mcp_tools.title: Pump conveyor motor suitability check
mcp_tools.description: Submit a pump/conveyor drive manifest (declared duty and operating point, motor sizing, pump and conveyor records, baselines, interface and protection, declared drives with required duty vs motor ratings); get a deterministic SUITABLE / NOT_SUITABLE / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across six sections, including computed rated-vs-required power/torque, NPSH and starting-torque checks, with per-check evidence. Declared values only; nothing is measured.

inputSchema.description: The pump/conveyor suitability manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and the drives[] schema).

equipment_kind.description: Equipment kind: pump | conveyor | mixed — gates the kind-specific sections.

pump_checks.description: Pump evidence (declared; NPSH/flow comparisons are computed from drives[]).

conveyor_checks.description: Conveyor evidence (declared; starting-torque comparison is computed from drives[]).

interface_and_protection.description: Interface and protection evidence (incl. the engineering-review red line).

drives.description: Declared drives: required duty vs motor ratings; pump entries add NPSH + flow fields, conveyor entries add starting-torque fields.

expect.notes: All checks pass. Computed spot checks: min_power_margin_kw=5.0000, min_npsh_margin_m=2.0000
